cases.trigger_and_control: rich source 正常采用与 foreign rights
cases.must_assert: Actual bootstrap, SOURCE_ONLY draft and controlled adoption produce committed rich source; actual workspace/reader consumes it; preserve producer/rights/consumer identities.
cases.scope: 保留原阶段门

cases.trigger_and_control: 同名双根，替换仅一侧，含空目录/嵌套
cases.must_assert: Committed source and workspace retain independent physical trees; equal relative paths never collapse resource ownership; nested and empty directories are separate evidence.
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 稳定原树对照 inode/parent/root/mtime/symlink/foreign lease/stale generation
cases.must_assert: Same bytes/new inode, parent/root replacement, same-size/restored mtime, symlink, copied/foreign/released capability and stale base/control/owner/generation are refused before authoritative use.
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 逐项改依赖、补 negative、增空目录/改 listing，对照稳定重读
cases.must_assert: Positive/negative style/settings/markers/subtitle/translation dependencies, added empty directory and actual listing changes invalidate stale proofs.
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 真实产物对照 forged JSON、foreign、staged 和撤销
cases.must_assert: Unknown/forged native metadata or cache refused; concrete approved producer derivation invalidates old round, then stable proven native derivation can be read; no broad cache whitelist.
cases.scope: 保留原阶段门

cases.trigger_and_control: 固定实际媒体、parent FD，对照路径换名与超限
cases.must_assert: Fixed local ffprobe uses same held parent-PID FD; normalized duration/first-video/fps/rotation/audio/dimensions and provenance match pinned upstream; no injected facts.
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 正常与超时、取消、abrupt、输出过界；延迟 close
cases.must_assert: Timeout/cancel/abrupt child: actual child exit and reap precede input release; limits refuse rather than truncate; diagnostic media never represents Chinese A films.
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 固定 BOM/CRLF、数字名及独立 caption listing
cases.must_assert: Exact UTF8/BOM/CRLF/native_rev vectors; numeric localeCompare video ordering vs separate actual caption readdir order; Node/ICU/locale recorded.
cases.scope: 保留原阶段门

cases.trigger_and_control: 每项预算边界与第一个超限、读取中增长
cases.must_assert: Size checks precede bounded text read; growth, total bytes, path/depth/FD/output/time bounds have explicit rejection; no unbounded media read.
cases.scope: 保留原阶段门

cases.trigger_and_control: 临时 walk 与下一 allocation 共用整数，对照无复用
cases.must_assert: Descriptor allocation generations own closes; recycled integer after temporary directory walk still closes newly retained allocation exactly once; no raw numeric retry.
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 逐项 open/stat/verify/close/reentry，双错误与全成功对照，详见验收矩阵
cases.must_assert: Nth open/stat/verify/close/reentry failures preserve primary and all cleanup errors; every outstanding resource attempted; sticky uncertainty prevents new proof.
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 分别在交付前后 close、晚到 resolve/reject/release fault
cases.must_assert: Close drains accepted reads and probes; success transfers source/workspace plus directory/negative guards; reader close cannot destroy delivered resources.
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 两 lease 同 ref、复制对象、外国实例、换 generation
cases.must_assert: Releasing one acquired lease does not revoke ref or another lease; repeated proof works; issuing instance checked and replaced generation invalidates prior proof.
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 原 84 断言、legacy refusal、批准的 loader exports 对照
cases.must_assert: Original render SnapshotReadPort, legacy refusal and accepted Expected lifecycle/84 assertions preserved; loader only approved015 minimal exports, no artifact/pin change.
cases.scope: 保留原阶段门

cases.trigger_and_control: 当前授权全集与原十路径及新增项、陈旧 pin 负控
cases.must_assert: Exact ten-file diff and protected hashes checked; unique captures retain all failures, source/index immutable during commands, actual exits and source/artifact SHA256 verified.
cases.scope: 保留原阶段门

cases.trigger_and_control: 绑定最终 SHA；实现者自签或陈旧审查作反控
cases.must_assert: Freeze actual candidate and obtain independent review bound to it; fix then reverify affected gates. No self-signed external pass.
cases.scope: 保留原阶段门

cases.production_entry: NEXT contract → 既有接线验收入口
cases.trigger_and_control: 已接受 commit 与未接受 WIP 对照，重锚 28 case
cases.must_assert: After N1N2 acceptance freeze compatible next-stage contract and exact implementation/acceptance plan; no premature S01/NativeAck/Studio/film/A readiness claim.
cases.scope: 保留原阶段门

cases.production_entry: fixed producer → 两次 draw/poster → lookup
cases.trigger_and_control: 实际两帧和配对 poster 对照 key 不匹配
cases.must_assert: 真实连续两帧与poster可生成；缓存key/算法不变；跨draw进程隔离不破坏成功体验
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 正常与真实 15/45 秒原超时、外层 60 秒
cases.must_assert: 真实seek15秒与JOB45秒原始错误可达，外层60秒不遮盖JOB；每项真正结束原生执行域
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 实际资源加具名 barrier 与无 barrier
cases.must_assert: capture30秒通过真实资源与明确标注transport barrier命中；不得声称自然卡顿
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 原失败后继续执行与自然完成
cases.must_assert: late launch/newPage continuation在错误后也不能越过执行域清理；无旧work继续读PRE
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 异根实际并行，对比同根别名排队
cases.must_assert: 不同物理根两个真实worker并行，清理A时B存活并成功；同根别名仍共享锁
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 在每个 PRE/POST、drain、release、activation 边缘排入同根竞争者；preexisting 早拒绝
cases.must_assert: 完整同根锁覆盖preexisting-output/PRE/worker/drain/POST/两个tree释放/最终门/witness激活
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: GO 前后断管/取消再 close，对比自然结束
cases.must_assert: close/cancel/私有断管含GO前、GO后；重复close只结算释放一次；不交付晚到结果
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 协议/JPEG/两路输出越界与界内
cases.must_assert: 真实协议、JPEG、stdout/stderr洪水有界拒绝并真正清理；无先反序列化巨对象
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 真实 TERM-ignore 与普通退出
cases.must_assert: TERM-ignore转KILL实际回收；child close+组ESRCH+已知后代消失含Z，信号成功不是结束
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: leader 突退、EPERM、归属未知与原 epoch 确证终局
cases.must_assert: leader意外退出、EPERM、未知归属不盲杀/伪settled；PRE、FD、scope、容量均不释放
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 同一 handle 并发、旧 JSON/PID/foreign、晚到真实终局
cases.must_assert: 真实私有handle reconcile以新鲜证明结算恰好一次；伪handle、旧JSON/PID不能签发成功
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 响应 abort 时源仍活；完整读取正控
cases.must_assert: 真实range源流在响应中止后曾存活且最终close；响应close不能替代源FD close
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 父 probe 跨 worker 退出与先结束，对照 callback/close/reap
cases.must_assert: 真实父frameDuration probe跨worker结束仍被等待并reap；需明确原回调是否覆盖真实child close
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 冻结边缘新请求、已接受请求、下一 draw 重开
cases.must_assert: 执行域消失后同步封资源准入；冻结边界的新请求不访问源/创建probe；下一draw显式重开
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 完整候选、late error、最终换源、仅 SIGKILL
cases.must_assert: 完整候选→单调FINALIZE_AFTER_OK→授权终止→真实结算→最终源/witness门；不得倒填或由SIGKILL推成功
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 2 active、32 global/8 same root、30 秒队列及取消
cases.must_assert: 两活跃scope、32全局/8同根排队、30秒队列截止；超额/取消在PRE前拒绝且不生child/泄漏FD
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.trigger_and_control: 读同根/异根、交付瞬间同根变忙、producer 自身活跃
cases.must_assert: reader准入及最终交付同时查对应物理根；generic production lease不因自己的活跃scope自我失效
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证

cases.production_entry: pinned Chrome → R6 terminal → workspace drain
cases.trigger_and_control: 本版 policy/实际后代整组退出，旧 policy 负控
cases.must_assert: 当前worker/policy原字节下真实Chrome/zygote/renderer/utility继承与整组退出；旧policy证据不复用
cases.scope: R7 接缝及原阶段联合复证
